Grace learned a lot about music. Grace wrote about the day in the diary. The weather was sunny that day. Also, lions rest in shade on the savanna.
Grace is going to travel to London in February. Both of them like rice and water. Sam is interested in singing. The weather forecast says rain tonight.
Grace drinks water after doing sports. Grace hopes to visit London one day. Life is full of small surprises.
